raids.raidLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still, a gold flash in the grass, gone when you look, a toad like a war drum, throat swelling, a red moon rising between the trees, breathing) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.
